title: Hindu Calendar Months: Names, English Equivalents and Amanta vs Purnimanta Explained
seoTitle: Hindu Calendar Months Names, English Equivalents & Festivals
seoDescription: The 12 Hindu months, Chaitra to Phalguna, with English equivalents, a festival for each, amanta vs purnimanta, Adhik Maas and the Saka national calendar.
excerpt: One table maps all 12 masas to Gregorian months and festivals, then shows why Diwali and Shivaratri carry two month names, when the next Adhik Maas falls, and how the Saka calendar differs.
